steps.label: Actuals landed: October orders + settlements

steps.label: Completeness DMFs per feed
Fallback: settle from the billing ledger for the late file

steps.label: Reconcile: orders ↔ payments ↔ credit memos

steps.sql: SELECT MIN(completeness) >= 0.99 AND ABS(SUM(diff)) = 0 FROM SDP_JIMDO_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.V_CLOSE_STATUS WHERE period = '2026-10';

bots.name: Variance Explainer
bots.tagline: Computes the units × price × retention bridge by business line and writes commentary grounded only in those numbers.

steps.label: Units × price × retention bridge by business line
steps.sql:
SELECT business_line,
  (fc_units - bud_units) * bud_price AS volume_eff,
  (fc_price - bud_price) * fc_units AS price_eff,
  retention_eff
FROM SDP_JIMDO_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.V_TOPLINE_BRIDGE WHERE fiscal_year = 2026;
steps.result: FY2026 landing EUR 72.0M vs EUR 75.7M budget · largest driver: New Business −EUR 2.7M

steps.label: Rank top drivers (|effect| ≥ EUR 0.1M)
steps.sql: SELECT * FROM SDP_JIMDO_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.BRIDGE_RESULT WHERE ABS(effect) >= 1e5 QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ABS(effect) DESC) <= 5;
steps.result: New Business −2.7M, Cross-sell & Upsell −0.4M, Renewals −0.4M (first-renewal retention)

steps.label: AI_COMPLETE commentary (grounded in step 3 only)
steps.result: Commentary drafted (152 words) · numeric check: 9/9 figures match bridge

steps.label: Guardrail: every number in text exists in bridge
Draft commentary to the P&L Summary + dashboard
steps.result: Draft published (badge: Written by Variance Explainer)

guardrails.label: Grounding
guardrails.rule: Every figure in the text must exist in the bridge result

guardrails.label: Materiality
guardrails.rule: Only drivers above threshold are explained

bots.ddl:
-- Deployable spec (not executed in demo mode)
CREATE OR REPLACE TASK SDP_JIMDO_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.T_VARIANCE_EXPLAINER
  WAREHOUSE = SDP_BOT_WH
  AFTER SDP_JIMDO_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.T_CLOSE_SENTINEL
  CONFIG = '{"autonomy": 2}'
AS
  CALL SDP_JIMDO_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.SP_RUN_BOT('variance-explainer');

-- step 1 · Close Sentinel succeeded
-- Task graph: AFTER SDP_JIMDO_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.T_CLOSE_SENTINEL
-- step 2 · Units × price × retention bridge by business line
SELECT business_line,
  (fc_units - bud_units) * bud_price AS volume_eff,
  (fc_price - bud_price) * fc_units AS price_eff,
  retention_eff
FROM SDP_JIMDO_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.V_TOPLINE_BRIDGE WHERE fiscal_year = 2026;
-- step 3 · Rank top drivers (|effect| ≥ EUR 0.1M)
SELECT * FROM SDP_JIMDO_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.BRIDGE_RESULT WHERE ABS(effect) >= 1e5 QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ABS(effect) DESC) <= 5;
-- step 4 · AI_COMPLETE commentary (grounded in step 3 only)
SELECT AI_COMPLETE('claude-sonnet-4-5',
  'Write FP&A commentary using ONLY these figures: ' || OBJECT_CONSTRUCT(*)::STRING)
FROM SDP_JIMDO_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.BRIDGE_RESULT_TOP5;
-- step 5 · Guardrail: every number in text exists in bridge
SELECT SDP_JIMDO_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.FN_NUMBERS_GROUNDED(:commentary, 'BRIDGE_RESULT_TOP5');
-- step 6 · Draft commentary to the P&L Summary + dashboard
INSERT INTO SDP_JIMDO_TEASER.PUBLIC.REPORT_NARRATIVE_LOG (page, text, source) VALUES ('pnl-summary', :commentary, 'SNOWBOT:variance-explainer');

bots.ddl:
-- Deployable spec (not executed in demo mode)
CREATE OR REPLACE TASK SDP_JIMDO_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.T_ROLLING_FORECAST
  WAREHOUSE = SDP_BOT_WH
  AFTER SDP_JIMDO_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.T_CLOSE_SENTINEL
  CONFIG = '{"autonomy": 3}'
AS
  CALL SDP_JIMDO_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.SP_RUN_BOT('rolling-forecast');

-- step 1 · Close Sentinel succeeded
-- Task graph: AFTER SDP_JIMDO_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.T_CLOSE_SENTINEL
-- step 2 · Retrain SNOWFLAKE.ML.FORECAST per region × term × cohort
CREATE OR REPLACE SNOWFLAKE.ML.FORECAST SDP_JIMDO_TEASER.ML.RETENTION_MODEL(
  INPUT_DATA => TABLE(SDP_JIMDO_TEASER.PUBLIC.V_RETENTION_HISTORY), SERIES_COLNAME => 'SERIES',
  TIMESTAMP_COLNAME => 'PERIOD', TARGET_COLNAME => 'RETENTION');
-- step 3 · Guardrail: 12-month backtest beats the workbook
SELECT ML_WAPE, WORKBOOK_WAPE FROM SDP_JIMDO_TEASER.PUBLIC.V_JIMDO_BACKTEST_SUMMARY;

-- step 5 · Promote to current forecast (approval)
CALL SDP_JIMDO_TEASER.PUBLIC.SP_PROMOTE_VERSION('Q4 draft', approved_by => :approver);

-- Deployable spec (not executed in demo mode)
CREATE OR REPLACE TASK SDP_JIMDO_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.T_GL_MAPPER
  WAREHOUSE = SDP_BOT_WH
  SCHEDULE = 'USING CRON 0 6 * * * Europe/Berlin'
  CONFIG = '{"autonomy": 3}'
AS

INSERT INTO SDP_JIMDO_TEASER.PUBLIC.MAP_ITEM SELECT ... FROM SDP_JIMDO_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.ITEM_MAP_PROPOSALS WHERE confidence >= 0.92;

bots.name: Retention Sentinel
bots.tagline: Daily first-renewal retention check by region and item; quantifies renewal net sales at risk.
bots.trigger: Stream on renewal orders and cancellations

steps.label: First-renewal vs older-cohort retention
steps.sql:
SELECT s.region, s.item, SUM(c.POTENTIAL_YOUNG * c.RET_YOUNG) / NULLIF(SUM(c.POTENTIAL_YOUNG), 0) AS first_renewal
FROM SDP_JIMDO_TEASER.PUBLIC.JIMDO_COHORT_SERIES c JOIN SDP_JIMDO_TEASER.PUBLIC.JIMDO_SERIES s USING (SERIES_ID) GROUP BY 1, 2;
steps.result: First renewal ~71% vs 79% older cohorts · weakest Dolphin START 68.5%, France 69.2%

steps.label: Value of one point of retention
steps.sql: SELECT SUM(potential * 0.01 * net_price) FROM SDP_JIMDO_TEASER.PUBLIC.V_RENEWAL_POTENTIAL WHERE fiscal_year = 2027;
steps.result: +1pp retention = EUR 0.74M FY2027 renewal net sales

steps.label: Draft win-back proposal
steps.result: Draft: first-renewal reminder + discount test for Dolphin START
